rules.title: Rent control ballot question (struck from 2026 ballot)
rules.requirement: A proposed ballot question to limit yearly rent increases in Massachusetts was blocked by the Supreme Judicial Court and will not go before voters in November 2026. It is not law.
rules.requirement_es: Una propuesta de pregunta electoral para limitar los aumentos anuales de alquiler en Massachusetts fue bloqueada por la Corte Suprema Judicial y no se presentará a los votantes en noviembre de 2026. No es ley.
rules.coverage_text: Proposed statewide limit on annual rent increases for residences, with exemptions for several types of units, including ones operated solely for religious purposes.

exemptions.label: Units operated solely for religious purposes

all.value_text: Unit operated solely for religious purposes

rules.quote: The state’s Supreme Judicial Court ruled a ballot question seeking to bring rent control back to Massachusetts cannot go forward this November, because it includes a religious exemption.
